# egui-winit

[![Latest version](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/egui-winit.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/egui-winit)
[![Documentation](https://docs.rs/egui-winit/badge.svg)](https://docs.rs/egui-winit)
![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)
![Apache](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache-blue.svg)

This crates provides bindings between [`egui`](https://github.com/emilk/egui) and [`winit`](https://crates.io/crates/winit).

The library translates winit events to egui, handled copy/paste, updates the cursor, open links clicked in egui, etc.

fesTerm's default-off `external-ime` feature leaves native IME visibility,
purpose and cursor geometry to the host, including viewport commands. Only
the Android host enables it: its field-aware input connection must not compete
with NativeActivity's built-in input view. Other platforms retain upstream
IME behavior.
